theater: 陝西綏德大順城與甘肅熙河洮岷

battle.name: 西夏、吐蕃攻宋之戰
battle.theater: 陝西綏德大順城與甘肅熙河洮岷
battle.brief: 元祐年間，西夏與吐蕃木征部在宋夏、宋蕃兩線同時用兵：夏軍攻陝西綏德、大順城一線，吐蕃進逼甘肅熙河、洮岷，宋廷以堡寨固守、招撫並用，迫西夏議和、綏德歸宋。卡面希臘火是拜占庭裝在銅管裡的海戰燃燒劑，此役無從置喙；同期可對照者，是《武經總要》所載猛火油櫃與火藥箭。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 這是一場發生在北宋元祐年間（一〇八六至一〇八八）陝甘邊境的三方衝突，交戰方並非兩國，而是宋、西夏與吐蕃木征部組成的兩路聯軍。宋方由樞密院統兵，陝西分鄜延、環慶、涇原、秦鳳、熙河五路，各置經略使節制：鄜延、環慶鎮守綏德、大順城、鹽池一線的前出堡寨，熙河一路則經營熙、洮、岷諸州與新建寨堡。兵種上以步軍弓箭手為骨幹，輔以神臂弓、步弩、長槍手與盾牌手，京師禁軍精銳僅在關鍵時換防調用；沿邊推行營田與弓箭手屯田，兵食合一，軍隊自帶農具與種子，這是元祐年間邊防體系與熙寧年間最大的不同。西夏以興慶府樞密院調度，邊軍由漢兵、橫山羌兵與御營精騎組成，重甲衝鋒的鐵鷂子是突陣主力，配大盾、拒馬與西夏強弩；其前線堡寨沿羅山道串聯，綏德城是伸入宋境最遠的据點，攻下即得屯兵之所，又可窺視宋地。吐蕃木征部則據河、洮、熙、岷一帶草場，以部落聯盟的形式自統兵眾，部眾以標槍、弓箭、長刀與皮甲為主，善山地游擊而不習攻堅。兩路聯軍在時間上互相策應：西夏在陝西正面施壓，逼迫宋廷把兵力和糧運調向鄜延、環慶，吐蕃便可乘隙在熙河得手；宋廷最忌的正是這種兩面作戰的格局。
countriesEn: This was a three-cornered clash on the Shaanxi–Gansu frontier during the Yuanyou years (1086–1088) of the Northern Song, and the belligerents were not two states but two coordinated fronts: the Song on one side, and on the other the Western Xia and the Tibetan host of Muzheng. On the Song side the Privy Council held the military command, and Shaanxi was divided into five circuits — Fuyan, Huanqing, Jingyuan, Qinlong and Xihe — each under a regional commissioner. Fuyan and Huanqing guarded the forward forts of Suide, Dashun City and the salt flats, while the Xihe circuit administered the prefectures of Xi, Tao and Min together with the chain of new forts. The backbone of the army was infantry archers, supported by divine-arm crossbows, foot crossbows, spearmen and shield-bearers, with the elite imperial guards brought up only for rotation and relief. Along the frontier the Song pushed tuntian and archer-farmer colonies, so that a soldier tilled his own field and grew his own grain: the army carried its own tools and seed, and this was the great difference between the frontier system of the Yuanyou era and that of the Xining era. Western Xia directed operations from the Privy Council at the Xingqing capital. Its frontier army combined Han troops, Hengshan Qiang auxiliaries and the imperial camp cavalry, with the armoured shock corps called the Tieyaozi as the spearhead of an assault, supported by large shields, horse obstacles and the strong Xia crossbows; its forward forts were strung along the Luoshan road, and Suide City was the outpost pushed furthest into Song territory, worth taking both as a place to quarter troops and as a vantage from which to watch the Song border. The Tibetan host of Muzheng held the pastures of He, Tao, Xi and Min and governed its fighting men as a loose tribal confederation; its warriors fought with javelins, bows, long sabres and leather armour, and were at home in mountain skirmishing rather than in siege. The two fronts were timed to assist each other. Xia pressed on the Shaanxi front in order to force the Song to shift troops and grain towards Fuyan and Huanqing, so that Tibet could strike in Xihe; a war on two fronts was exactly what the Song court feared most.
people: 宋方關鍵人物是哲宗、宣仁聖烈皇太后與樞密院。元豐八年（一〇八五）十月神宗崩，哲宗年幼，高太后臨朝，行元祐更化，一意裁汰新法、撤罷邊吏、與西夏和議，但軍政大權仍歸樞密院節制。在熙河方向，經略官韓縉是此役最關鍵的將領，他主張因其地而收其部，一面以寨堡據險、以弓箭手屯田，一面招撫吐蕃小部、分化木征的聯盟，使宋軍不必以硬攻消耗兵力；曾經開闢熙河的元老王韶仍在朝中參預方略，其經營熙河的辦法在元祐初年被重新起用。鄜延、環慶一線的守將在綏德失守後力主收復，朝廷則以不可深入、恐生後患為由節制出兵。西夏方面，主語祚名存實亡，母后沒臷氏以梁氏女主當國，樞密院承其意志：一面命邊軍攻宋陝西、配合吐蕃在熙河的攻勢，一面遣使入宋議和，以稱臣換取歲賜，這一手的關鍵人物是西夏樞密院與和議使臣。吐蕃方面，木征以受宋封號的名義維持合法地位，同時以部落首領的實力控制河、洮、熙、岷的兵權；他既不願放棄草場與牧地，也不願與宋廷全面翻臉，於是把西夏的進攻當作自身談判的籌碼，戰則可取寨、可以議則不折本。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Song side were the emperor Zhezong, the empress dowager Xuanren, and the Privy Council. In the tenth month of the eighth year of Yuanfeng (1085) Emperor Shenzong died, Zhezong was a child, and the empress dowager Gao took the regency and carried out the Yuanyou restoration, dismissing the new policies, withdrawing the frontier officials and opening peace talks with Western Xia; even so, military authority remained with the Privy Council. On the Xihe front the regional commissioner Han Jin was the single most important general of this campaign. He advocated taking the land and gathering the tribes, combining forts and hazardous ground with archer-farmer colonies on the one hand, and persuading the smaller Tibetan communities to come over while splitting Muzheng's confederation on the other, so that the Song army need not exhaust itself in frontal assaults. Wang Shao, the veteran who had opened up Xihe in the first place, still advised on strategy in the early Yuanyou years, and the method he had used to settle Xihe was taken up again. On the Fuyan and Huanqing lines the commanders at Suide argued for its recovery once the fortress had fallen; the court restrained the expeditions on the ground that a deep advance would invite trouble. On the Western Xia side the nominal emperor Liangzuo counted for little, and power lay with his mother, the empress dowager Mozan of the Liang clan, whose will was executed by the Privy Council. She ordered the frontier army to strike at Song territory in Shaanxi in coordination with the Tibetan move in Xihe, and simultaneously sent an embassy to the Song to sue for peace, offering to acknowledge Song overlordship in exchange for the annual gifts; the actors in that manoeuvre were the Xia Privy Council and its envoys. On the Tibetan side Muzheng held a legitimate standing through the titles the Song had conferred on him, while in fact commanding the fighting men of He, Tao, Xi and Min as a tribal lord. He would not surrender the pastures and grazing grounds, nor would he break with the Song court outright, so he treated the Xia offensive as a bargaining counter: if it succeeded he gained forts, and if it ended in negotiation he lost nothing.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘火：拜占庭帝國自七世紀起使用的配方不明的燃燒劑，裝在銅管與虹吸管中施放，主要用於水面艦船交鋒與圍城時焚燒敵艦、雲梯與糧秣堆，配方是帝國的機密，最後隨海戰與船一同沉沒。它的體系位置很清楚，銅管噴射器是固定在船首或城頭的燃燒火器，靠的是把可燃油料壓進管口再點著的機械原理，而不是任何可以單兵攜帶的兵器。這場戰爭在陝甘內陸邊境進行，沒有海港、沒有艦隊，希臘火在此沒有出現的條件；可以對照的，是北宋體系中同屬壓出可燃物再點火的裝備，《武經總要》所載的猛火油櫃，以皮囊盛油、銅管與唧筒噴出點燃，用於焚燒城樓與攻城器械，以及裹火藥於箭鏃的火藥箭，另有投擲火藥包的霹靂砲，一〇四四年成書的《武經總要》已載其形制。宋軍的常備冷兵器是神臂弓、步弩、長槍、大盾與刀槊，甲以皮甲、鎖子甲為主，攻城則備雲梯、穴地、撞竿、飛石與擺渡車；西夏的鐵鷂子披重甲而進，配長刀、標槍與拒馬，弩機拉力大而射速快；吐蕃兵以標槍、長刀、弓箭、木盾為主，衣著氌氈與皮甲，糧秣以馬、駱駝、犛牛馱運，箭鏈多為無齒之矢。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire: a burning mixture of unknown formulation used by the Byzantine Empire from the seventh century, discharged from bronze tubes and siphons, employed above all in naval engagements and in sieges to burn enemy shipping, scaling ladders and stacks of provisions. Its place in the imperial order of battle was unambiguous, for the bronze-tube projector was a fire weapon fixed to a ship's prow or to a wall, working on the mechanical principle of forcing a combustible liquid out of a pipe and igniting it, rather than anything a single man could carry. This war was fought on an inland frontier in Shaanxi and Gansu, with no harbour and no fleet, so the preconditions for Greek fire were simply absent. The closest counterparts in the Song system are the devices that also expel a burning substance and set it alight: the oil cabinet for fierce burning recorded in the Wujing Zongyao, which carried oil in a leather bladder and forced it out through a bronze pipe and piston to ignite city towers and siege engines; fire arrows with a charge of gunpowder bound to the head; and the thunder-thunder bomb that hurled packets of gunpowder, whose form the Wujing Zongyao of 1044 already records. The standing cold weapons of the Song army were the divine-arm crossbow, the foot crossbow, the spear, the large shield, the sabre and the glaive, with leather and lamellar armour; for siege they kept ladders, saps, battering rams, stone-throwers and movable siege towers. The Xia Tieyaozi charged in heavy armour with long sabre, javelin and horse obstacle, their crossbows powerful in draw and quick in rate of fire. The Tibetan warriors fought with javelin, long sabre, bow and wooden shield, wearing felt and leather, and moved their grain on horses, camels and yak; many of their arrows were blunt and meant for staggering a foe rather than for killing.
tactics: 三家的戰法可以分開來看。宋廷在元祐初年把邊防主軸從出擊改成守禦與築寨：在綏德、大順城、環慶、熙河沿線層層修築堡寨，寨與寨之間以烽火、驛騎相連，兵屯於寨，糧儲於寨，寨外開墾屯田；守寨以步軍長槍、弓弩列陣，倚寨牆拒馬、鹿角與弩機抵禦，遊騎負責偵察與遮斷敵方糧道，出兵不求遠襲，只求斷其游騎、絕其牧地。西夏的攻法以奇襲與內應為先，目標是宋境前出的堡寨本身，奪城即是奪取一個可以屯兵、可以窺視宋地的據點；若宋軍固守不開，便不再強攻，改以游騎在宋軍糧道兩側擾亂，迫宋分兵護運，這與此前宋夏戰爭中夏軍的慣用辦法一致。吐蕃部眾的戰法最不倚重攻城，他們依山地草場進退，以游騎襲擾邊寨，奪取寨中糧草、牲畜與器械，破了就走，遇到寨牆堅固、弓弩齊備便退避，說穿了是騷擾戰而不是決戰。宋廷對付這種難以追剿的打法用了兩手：一是因其地而收其部，把小部吐蕃收編為蕃兵，給以名分與糧餉，使其不必再依附木征；二是遣使議和，把西夏從熙河的牽制中拉開。三方在這個階段都沒有條件打一場決定性的會戰。
tacticsEn: The methods of the three sides are best taken one at a time. The Song court in the early Yuanyou years shifted the axis of frontier defence from attack to holding and to fortification. Forts were built in layers along the lines of Suide, Dashun City, Huanqing and Xihe, linked to one another by beacon fires and relay riders, with the soldiers quartered in the forts and the grain stored in them, and fields reclaimed outside the walls. The garrison fought the battle of the fort with spearmen and crossbowmen drawn up in line, relying on the palisade, on horse obstacles and caltrops, and on the bolt-throwers set in the wall, while flying cavalry reconnoitred and cut the enemy's supply road. Expeditions were not sent far; the object was to break the enemy's mounted patrols and to close off his pastures. The Xia method of attack began with surprise and with agents inside the walls, the object being the Song forts pushed out in advance: to take a fort was to take a place where troops could be quartered and from which Song territory could be watched. If the Song held firm, the Xia did not press the assault but reverted to harrying the two flanks of the Song baggage road with cavalry, forcing the Song to detach troops to escort it, exactly as the Xia had done in the earlier Song–Xia wars. The Tibetan war band was the least dependent on siege. It moved in and out along the mountain pastures, harassing the border forts with flying cavalry, seizing grain, livestock and equipment, and leaving again; where the walls stood firm and the crossbows were ready it withdrew. In plain terms this was a war of attrition by harassment rather than a set-piece battle. The Song met that sort of warfare, which could not be run to ground, with two measures. First, taking the land and gathering the tribes: smaller Tibetan communities were enrolled as fan soldiers, given rank and rations, so that they no longer had to cling to Muzheng. Second, envoys were sent to negotiate, so as to pull Western Xia away from the grip it held on Xihe. In this stage none of the three parties was in a position to fight a decisive engagement.
data: 關於兵力的數字，歷代記載多有誇大，只能取其大概。西夏攻綏德的兵馬，各家記作數萬之眾，實際投入的當在數千至萬餘之間；綏德城內宋軍守卒連同民兵，記錄多稱數百至千餘人，缺口由內應打開，戰後宋方被俘的將校與士卒以百計。熙河方向的宋軍沒有集中的大軍，主力是各寨的堡兵與蕃兵，總數當以數千計，一州一寨分散屯守；吐蕃參戰的部眾是臨時集合的部落聯盟，多則數千、少則數百，並沒有可靠的總數。距離上，綏德距環慶約二百里，環慶至熙州沿渭水與六盤山道約一千二百里，宋軍的糧車隊走這條線需要一個月以上，急行軍則以日行數十里計；自熙州至木征控制的河州草場，又是數百里山路。時間上，西夏攻綏德在元祐元年（一〇八六）九月，一〇八七年春夏雙方在熙河、洮岷再戰，西夏遣使議和與復置榷場在一〇八七年秋；熙河方向的爭端則一直拖到一一〇四年木征降宋、熙河六州盡入於宋才算收束。此外可以確定的是：宋每年自秦鳳、熙河一線買馬以數千匹計，邊軍糧食靠秦鳳、涇原轉輸的屯田與軍儲，兩者的開支才是雙方撐住邊防的關鍵。
dataEn: The figures for the armies are given inconsistently by the records and can only be taken as rough indications. The troops with which Western Xia moved against Suide are described in the various sources as tens of thousands, while the number actually committed was probably in the thousands to somewhat over ten thousand. The Song garrison of Suide, counting the militia, is put by the records at several hundred to a little over a thousand men; the breach was opened from within by agents, and after the fall the Song officers and soldiers taken prisoner were counted by the hundred. On the Xihe front the Song had no concentrated field army: the strength lay in the garrisons of the forts and in the Tibetan auxiliaries, in the low thousands overall, quartered in scattered posts, one preffecture and one fort at a time. The Tibetan contingents were tribal contingents mustered for the occasion, sometimes several thousand strong and sometimes only a few hundred, and no dependable total exists. In distance, Suide lies about two hundred li from Huanqing, and the road from Huanqing to Xizhou along the Wei valley and the Liupan range is about twelve hundred li; a Song grain convoy needed a month or more to move along it, while a forced march was reckoned at some tens of li a day. From Xizhou to the pastures of Hezhou held by Muzheng lay several hundred li of mountain road. In time, the Xia attack on Suide fell in the ninth month of the first year of Yuanyou (September 1086); the two sides fought again in Xihe and Taomin in the spring and summer of 1087; and the Xia embassy seeking peace together with the reopening of the markets came in the autumn of 1087. The dispute in the Xihe direction dragged on until 1104, when Muzheng came over and the six prefectures of Xihe passed entirely to the Song. Two further things can be stated with confidence: the Song bought horses in the thousands every year from Qinlong and the Xihe region, and the grain of the frontier armies came from the tuntian and the depots fed through Qinlong and Jingyuan. The cost of these two items is what allowed both sides to sustain a frontier at all.
cause: 打起來的原因是三層湊在一起。第一層是宋廷自身的變動：元豐八年神宗崩，哲宗幼年即位，高太后臨朝行元祐更法，罷新法、撤邊兵、遣使與西夏吐蕃議和，邊防空虛，前出堡寨守備單薄；這在宋廷看來是收拾舊釁、重建和局的時機，在西夏看來卻是可乘之機。第二層是西夏自身的目標：梁太后掌政後，羅山道與綏德一線的堡寨仍在宋軍手中，夏人失了前哨與牧地，必須奪回綏德與羅山東段，才能重新把宋軍擋在鹽池以西；她一面用兵、一面遣使，是要用邊境上的既得事實換取宋廷在歲賜與榷場上的讓步。第三層是吐蕃的立場：木征部控制的河、洮、熙、岷一帶正是宋廷正在經營的熙河路，寨堡一築、屯田一開，牧地與水源就逐步被收編，木征不會坐視宋軍把寨子一直築到河州門口；因此他與西夏在時間上配合，兩面施壓，逼宋廷把有限的兵力和財政分散到兩條線上。三方之中，只有宋廷打算用議和、築寨、招撫慢慢解決問題，夏與吐蕃都希望速戰速決。
causeEn: The clash came about because three causes converged. The first was a change in the Song court itself. In 1085 Emperor Shenzong died, Zhezong succeeded as a child, and the empress dowager Gao took the regency and carried out the Yuanyou restoration, dismissing the new policies, withdrawing the frontier troops and sending envoys to negotiate with Western Xia and with Tibet. The frontier was left thin and the forward forts were held by few men. To the Song court this was the moment to tidy up old grievances and rebuild a working peace; to Western Xia it was an opening to be used. The second was the object of Western Xia itself. Under the regency of the empress dowager Liang, the forts along the Luoshan road and at Suide were still in Song hands; the Xia had lost their outposts and their pastures, and had to retake Suide and the eastern stretch of the Luoshan road if they were to hold the Song back on the far side of the salt flats. Her combination of fighting and negotiating was deliberate: she meant to use faits accomplis on the border to obtain concessions from the Song in the annual gifts and in the frontier markets. The third was the position of Tibet. The He, Tao, Xi and Min pastures under Muzheng were exactly the territory that the Song was turning into the Xihe circuit; once forts were built and tuntian opened, pasture and water were being absorbed one piece at a time, and Muzheng would not sit still while Song forts advanced to the gates of Hezhou. He therefore coordinated with Western Xia in time, pressing on two fronts so as to force the Song to spread a limited force and a limited treasury over two lines. Of the three parties only the Song meant to solve the problem slowly, by negotiation, by fortification and by absorption; Xia and Tibet both wanted it settled quickly.
impact: 這場邊境戰爭沒有分出勝負，卻改變了三方的長期格局。就宋方而言，綏德歸宋之後，羅山道前沿的堡寨體系被重新整頓，熙河、洮岷一線的寨堡與屯田體系在往後十餘年裡不斷加密，卒之一一〇四年木征率部眾降宋，熙、河、洮、岷、疊、巘六州盡入版圖，宋朝自此在西側取得了通向青唐與河西的通道，這條通道在二十餘年後成為宋軍西征與經營河湟的支點。就西夏而言，元祐年間的和議讓夏廷得以以稱臣之名年年得銀絹茶綵，境內得以喘息，但同時也把夏廷的對宋外交固定在年年進貢的格局裡，而宋方新立的寨堡與屯田步步進逼，削弱了夏人在羅山與熙河的傳統優勢；夏人此後每一次用兵，都要把此前讓出的通道重新奪回。就戰爭方法而言，這一時期宋夏邊防的技術變化清楚可見：堡寨與屯田成為邊軍的生存基礎，弩機、猛火油櫃、火藥箭等火器裝備的比重上升，遠程打擊與野地防守的重要性壓過了突騎衝鋒。對後來的邊防政策而言，宋廷在西北以守代攻、以屯養兵的取向，被金、元兩朝在北方邊疆的做法所承繼。
impactEn: This frontier war settled nothing on the field, yet it reshaped the long-term position of all three parties. For the Song, once Suide had returned, the chain of forts along the Luoshan road was reorganised, and the system of forts and tuntian on the Xihe and Taomin lines grew denser year by year for more than a decade, until in 1104 Muzheng came over with his people and the six prefectures of Xi, He, Tao, Min, Die and Xian passed entirely to the Song. The Song thus gained on its western side a road leading towards Qingtang and the Hexi corridor, and that road, a little over twenty years later, became the hinge of Song campaigning and administration in the region of Hehuang. For Western Xia, the peace of the Yuanyou years allowed the Xia court, under the fiction of vassalage, to receive its silver, silk and tea year after year and to catch its breath at home; but it also fixed Xia diplomacy towards the Song within the pattern of annual tribute, while the new Song forts and colonies pressed forward step by step and eroded the Xia advantage in Luoshan and Xihe. Every later Xia offensive had to be a bid to take back the roads that had been given up. In terms of method, the technical change in the Song–Xia frontier during these years is clearly visible: forts and cultivation became the basis of the frontier soldier's existence, while bolt-throwers, oil cabinets and fire arrows gained in relative weight, and long-range fire and field defence came to matter more than the charge of cavalry. For later frontier policy, the Song practice in the northwest of holding in place of attacking, and of paying for the frontier by farming it, was inherited by the Jin and Yuan courts on their northern borders.
result: 直接結果是西夏攻宋與吐蕃攻宋都沒有打到決定性的地步。西夏在綏德得手之後無法向縱深擴展，一〇八七年轉而遣使議和，宋夏重修貢市，歲賜如故，綏德歸還宋朝，兩國邊界大體回到戰前；吐蕃木征在熙河的攻勢同樣受阻，宋軍以寨堡與屯田固守，以招撫分化其部眾，木征始終未能在河、洮站穩，宋朝也沒有能力立刻把河州、洮州收入版籍。於是這場戰爭留下的不是一場戰役的勝負，而是一條漫長的收復之路：宋朝在熙河、洮岷的堡寨與屯田一年年推進，木征在宋廷的封賞與壓力下一步步退讓，到一一〇四年木征降宋，熙河六州歸宋，熙河路正式成路，邊界西推數千里。就宋廷而言，這是一場以時間換空間的邊防政策，贏在制度而不在一役；就西夏而言，它用歲賜換取了十數年的邊境安寧，代價是把主動權一點一點讓了出去；就吐蕃而言，它守住了河、洮的基本盤而失去了整個熙河的方向。三方都在元祐之後的邊界上重新找到了各自的立足點。
resultEn: The immediate result was that neither the Xia attack nor the Tibetan attack on the Song reached a decisive stage. After its success at Suide the Xia could not extend the penetration, and in 1087 it turned to negotiation instead: the Song and the Xia renewed the tributary relations, the annual gifts were restored, Suide was handed back to the Song, and the frontier broadly returned to where it had stood before. The Tibetan offensive in Xihe was checked in the same way; the Song held with forts and colonies and split Muzheng's following with inducements, and Muzheng never gained a secure footing in He and Tao, while the Song for its part lacked the strength to take Hezhou and Taozhou into the register at once. What the war left behind was therefore not a victory on any field but a long road of recovery: the Song advanced its forts and colonies in Xihe and Taomin year by year, and Muzheng yielded step by step before Song favour and Song pressure, until in 1104 he came over, the six prefectures of Xihe passed to the Song, the Xihe circuit was formally constituted, and the frontier was carried westward for several thousand li. For the Song this was a frontier policy that traded time for space, won by institutions rather than by any single engagement. For Western Xia it bought a decade or more of quiet on the border at the price of the annual gifts, but at the price too of surrendering the initiative piecemeal. For Tibet it preserved the core of He and Tao while losing the whole direction of Xihe. On the new frontier line drawn after Yuanyou, all three found again their own footing.
